nodes.label: Deepslate Texture
nodes.description: 16x16 pixel block texture of base deepslate stone (side face). Dark grey/charcoal with subtle layered strata lines giving a compressed sedimentary rock appearance. Used for underground cave and dungeon walls at deep depths.
nodes.pattern: subtle horizontal strata/layering with slight noise
nodes.game_purpose: base deep underground stone block, found below y=0, used for cave generation and dungeon walls
